newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D. rises after upbeat statement.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D. rises after upbeat statement.

text.p: Shares in electronic information group M.A.I.D. Plc rose on Thursday after an upbeat statement accompanying the company's third quarter results, traders said.
The shares gained 10-1/2p to 258p by 0903 GMT, bouncing back from yesterday's six-month low.

"Although all European and Far East divisions have shown excellent growth, by far the greatest rate of expansion has been in the United States, where revenues have grown by 93 percent," said M.A.I.D. in a statement.
It said customer growth continued at record levels with new customer gains up over 560 percent on Q3.
Traders said Merrill Lynch repeated a "strong buy" recommendation on the stock.
M.A.I.D. reported a pre-tax loss of 2.4 million stg in the third quarter compared to a loss of 3.4 million stg in the same period last year.
